query_text: Transfer money to my savings account

messages.content: Transfer money to my savings account

message.content:
To **transfer money to your savings account**, log in to your bank’s **online banking** or **mobile app** and look for **Transfers** or **Move money**, then choose your **checking account** as the source and your **savings account** as the destination.[1][4][6][7][9]

If you bank with the same institution, many banks let you transfer internally and the money may post **immediately** or by the **next business day**.[1][4][7] Some banks also let you set up **recurring transfers** to savings.[4][6][7][9]

If your savings account is at a **different bank**, you may need to **link an external account** first by entering the account and routing numbers and verifying small test deposits.[1][5][7] After that, you can submit a transfer request from your bank’s transfer page.[1][5][7]

If you want, I can give you the exact steps for your bank or app.
